name: SLM-Critical-governance-00001
description: System-level governance operations require system administrator privileges
business_justification: Critical system operations like role management and system configuration must be restricted to system administrators to prevent security breaches.

name: SLM-Critical-financial-00002
description: Critical financial operations like payment processing require treasurer privileges
business_justification: High-value payment processing and financial record creation must be restricted to treasurers to ensure financial integrity.

name: SLM-High-financial-00003
business_justification: Managers need access to financial operations like SEPA mandates and payment gateway sync for operational management.

name: SLM-High-financial-00004
description: Treasurer access to high-security financial operations
business_justification: Treasurers need comprehensive access to financial operations for their fiduciary responsibilities.

name: SLM-High-member_data-00005
description: Managers can access sensitive member data operations
business_justification: Managers need access to member data for operational decisions and member relationship management.

name: SLM-Medium-operations-00006
description: Staff operations for day-to-day administrative tasks
business_justification: Staff need access to operational functions for daily administrative tasks and member support.

name: SLM-Medium-member_data-00007
description: Staff access to member data for administrative support
business_justification: Staff need member data access to provide administrative support and answer member inquiries.

name: SLM-Medium-chapter_specific-00008
description: Board members can manage their chapter operations
business_justification: Chapter board members need operational access within their specific chapters for governance and management.

name: SLM-Low-operations-00009
description: Basic operational access for all members
business_justification: Members need basic operational access to participate in association activities and access member services.

name: SLM-Low-member_data-00010
description: Members can access basic member data operations
business_justification: Members need access to member directory and basic member information for community building.

name: SLM-Contextual-self_service-00011
description: Volunteers can perform self-service operations on their own data
business_justification: Volunteers need to submit their own expenses and manage their volunteer profiles without requiring staff intervention. Context validation ensures they can only access their own data.

name: SLM-Contextual-self_service-00012
description: Members can perform self-service operations on their own data
business_justification: Members need to manage their own profiles, submit applications, and access their own financial records.

name: SLM-Contextual-volunteer_operations-00013
description: Team leaders can manage volunteer operations for their teams
business_justification: Team leaders need to manage volunteer activities, approve team expenses, and coordinate team operations within their scope.

name: SLM-Contextual-financial-00014
description: Board members can approve chapter-specific financial operations
business_justification: Chapter board members need to approve expenses and financial operations for their specific chapters only.

name: SLM-Medium-compliance-00015
description: Kascommissie can access compliance and audit functions
business_justification: Audit committee members need access to compliance monitoring and financial audit functions for their oversight responsibilities.

name: SLM-Public-operations-00016
description: Webhook users for public API access
business_justification: Webhook integrations need access to specific public operations for external system integration.

name: SLM-Low-operations-00017
description: Auditors have low-level operational access for audit purposes
business_justification: External auditors need read-only access to operational data for audit and compliance verification.

name: SLM-Medium-financial-00018
description: Auditors need medium-level financial access for audit purposes
business_justification: External auditors require comprehensive financial data access for audit procedures and compliance verification.
